<thought>The 13C NMR shows one upfield signal at 52.24 ppm, which is typical for a methoxy (O‑CH₃) carbon. The other upfield signals (43.47 ppm and 38.60 ppm) are in the region for sp³ carbons attached to carbonyl or other substituents, not characteristic of methyl groups. Therefore, the molecule contains a single methyl group (the methoxy). The answer is 1.</thought>
<final_answer>1</final_answer>
